page.layout: One page of running text in the main column, with a narrow column of marginal notes on the right. The first paragraphs are in italic. A centred heading "De Gallinis." sits between the italic passage and the roman text. Text runs down the main column, then the right margin note. Below the text: catchword "pen-" and signature "Y 4".

p.i: Ex quibus patet, testes gallinaceorum inter ea, quae venerem excitant, feminisque ac spi-rituum generationi sunt accommoda, non po-stremum obtinuisse locum.
Verum tenendum, veterum gallorum testes virosos esse & effœtos, quare juniorum ad hanc rem assumendi sunt.

Delicatiores quoque fœmina in deliciis gula habent oropygia gallinaceorum & gallinarum, praesertim altilium & praepinguium, ac certum est ea boni succi esse, licet veterani milites oropygiorum voratores a quibusdam appellentur.Oropy-gium extrema pars spinæ est podici incubentis, der bura-sel[?]

main_text.head: De Gallinis.
main_text.p: Gallinaceae carnes, ut graves testantur autores, ipsaque experientia, praestantissimae sunt, facile enim concipiuntur, omnibusque naturis & temperamentis peridoneae sunt, ideoque alimenti precipui. Quapropter in villatica pastione cum suis pullis merito obtinent primas, ex iis enim numerosissima epularum genera fiunt, infinitosque mortalibus in re cibaria usus subministrant, nec alius cibus est, qui innocentius, tum aegris, tum sanis possit exhiberi. page.notes: Right margin note is printed in several short lines with hyphenation; its final word "sel." and the word after "bura" are doubtful. The initial G of "Gallinaceae" is a large woodcut-style letter joined to the word. Several words in the main text (e.g. "effœtos", "praepinguium") are read from the scan with some uncertainty. Heading "De Gallinis." is treated as a level 2 title above the passage.
